where: A brief's hand-off folder is runs/handoffs/<role>/<brand>/<brief key>/ (the Hand-off Standard's home), the same path in the repo and under Shared Assets/ on the Drive. The packages are image-edit handoff.py (graphic-designer) and video-edit editor_handoff.py (video-editor).
